source: Original teaching dialogues; synthesized speech, not official examination recordings.

units.title: A changed museum trip · 博物馆行程变更
units.transcript: Maya: Are we meeting at nine outside the library for the museum trip? Leo: The coach is delayed. Meet at nine thirty by the sports hall instead. Maya: Should I bring twelve dollars? Leo: The school has paid for transport, so you only need eight dollars for admission. Bring your own lunch because the cafe is closed. Maya: I wanted to see the robot exhibition. Leo: That opens next month. Today we will join a workshop on renewable energy. Maya: Good. I will bring my notebook and lunch.

items.explain: Leo changes the original nine o'clock plan to nine thirty.
items.explainZh: 九点是原计划，后来明确改为九点半。

items.prompt: Where is the new meeting point?
items.explain: The new instruction is to meet by the sports hall instead.
items.explainZh: instead 表示替代原地点，改在体育馆旁。

items.prompt: How much must each student bring for admission?
items.zh: 每位学生需带多少门票费？
items.explain: Transport is paid for, but admission still costs eight dollars.
items.explainZh: 学校支付交通费，但学生仍需带八美元门票费。

items.prompt: What will the group do today?
items.zh: 团队今天将参加什么活动？
items.explain: The robot exhibition opens next month; today's activity concerns renewable energy.
items.explainZh: 机器人展下个月才开，今天是可再生能源工作坊。

units.title: Choosing a school club · 选择学校社团
units.transcript: Tutor: You said you wanted to join the debating club, Nina. Nina: I did, but it meets on Tuesday, when I have swimming practice. Tutor: The science club meets on Thursday. Would that work? Nina: Yes. I used to think science club meant listening to lectures, but I heard members design their own experiments. Tutor: They do. This term they are testing ways to save water in the school garden. Nina: That sounds useful. Is there a fee? Tutor: Membership is free. Bring a notebook, but the equipment is provided. Nina: Then I will try a session before deciding whether to join for the whole term.

items.prompt: Why does Nina not choose the debating club?
items.zh: Nina 为什么不选辩论社？
items.explain: Debating meets on Tuesday, at the same time as her swimming practice.
items.explainZh: 辩论社与周二游泳训练时间冲突。

items.prompt: What appeals to Nina about science club?
items.zh: 科学社哪一点吸引 Nina？
items.explain: Her interest increases when she learns that members design their own experiments.
items.explainZh: 得知成员可以自行设计实验后，她产生了兴趣。

items.prompt: What is this term's project about?
items.zh: 本学期项目的主题是什么？
items.explain: Members are testing ways to save water in the school garden.
items.explainZh: 成员研究学校花园节水的方法。

items.prompt: Which best describes Nina's final attitude?
items.zh: 哪项最能描述 Nina 最后的态度？
options: Interested but wants to try first
items.answer: Interested but wants to try first
items.explain: She plans to try one session before committing to the whole term.
items.explainZh: 她有兴趣，但决定先体验一次再选择是否整学期参加。

units.title: Planning a research presentation · 筹备研究展示
units.transcript: Sam: Our presentation needs a strong conclusion. The survey shows that most students support reusable cups. Aisha: We only surveyed members of the environment club, though. We cannot say they represent the whole school. Sam: Then we should mention that limitation. Could we survey other classes tomorrow? Aisha: Yes, but we should keep the questions neutral. Asking why reusable cups are wonderful would push people towards a positive answer. Sam: Agreed. We can ask which type of cup they use and why. Aisha: Also, our deadline has moved from Friday to Monday. That gives us time to compare the answers, but not to claim that our survey proves what everyone thinks. Sam: I will revise the questionnaire, and you can prepare the charts.

items.prompt: What is the main weakness in the original survey?
items.zh: 原调查的主要弱点是什么？
options: Its sample was limited to one club
items.answer: Its sample was limited to one club
items.explain: Only environment-club members were surveyed, so the sample may not represent the whole school.
items.explainZh: 样本仅来自环保社，不能代表全校学生。

items.prompt: Why should the questions be neutral?
items.zh: 问题为什么应保持中立？
items.explain: Positive wording such as wonderful can lead respondents towards an expected answer.
items.explainZh: wonderful 等褒义措辞可能诱导受访者支持预设答案。

items.zh: 调整后的截止日期是什么时候？
items.explain: Aisha explicitly says the deadline has moved from Friday to Monday.
items.explainZh: Friday 是原日期，最终改为 Monday。

items.explain: Sam takes responsibility for revising the questionnaire; Aisha will prepare charts.
items.explainZh: Sam 修改问卷，Aisha 准备图表，注意区分分工。
